//server_url: What clients elsewhere should call. Defaults to localhost:<port>.
//watch: counts is one pgrep per name (cheap, keep it long); sessions costs a ps and a cwd lookup per match (keep it short).
//machines: One entry per physical machine. A machine with a 'local' endpoint is the one running the server. Dual-boot boxes list both sides: the Windows counter is host-wide truth (it includes the WSL2 VM), the WSL one is shown separately.

machines.name: workstation
machines.//wol: Optional. MAC addresses of the machine's NICs, plus the LAN broadcast address to send magic packets to.
